note: Catalog of the investigations named in the official NASA Space Apps challenge text (docs/08-reto-oficial.md). Each field holds only what that text says; a field the text does not state is "not stated". No test counts, DOIs or PSI ids are stored here: the two investigations with test-level data on this site take their count, PSI id and DOI from meta.json through "program".
curated_by: team, from the challenge text (AI-assisted transcription, human-reviewable against docs/08-reto-oficial.md)

earth_applications.text: Fine-water-mist extinguishers developed for use on the ISS have practical applications on Earth, and NASA technology has similarly led to improvements in terrestrial smoke detection and firefighter gear, including protective clothing and air tanks.
